sources.title: Hawaii Office of Elections: 2016 General Election final results by precinct (media.txt)
Hawaii Office of Elections: 2016 General Election final statewide summary (summary.txt)
Hawaii Office of Elections: 2016 General Election final summary report, City and County of Honolulu (cch.pdf)

method: pipeline/patches/2016_HI_HOUSE_honolulu.py sums absentee mail, absentee walk-in and election-day votes over the Oahu precincts (State House districts 17-51) for the regular U.S. Representative Dist I race (contest 3, wholly in Honolulu) and Dist II race (contest 5), leaving out the same-day Dist I Vacancy special election (contest 4). (D) candidates are dem, (R) rep, and Yim (L) and Griffin (N) oth; blank and over votes are excluded.
validation: HI-1 regular D 145,417 / R 45,958 / oth 10,982 equals the certified statewide summary and the Honolulu summary report exactly (0.00%); the Honolulu part of HI-2, D 57,922 / R 15,205, equals the Honolulu summary report exactly; precinct sums for both contests equal the statewide summary for every candidate. Honolulu total dem 203,339 / rep 61,163 / oth 10,982 (MIT had 347,846 / 105,253 / 20,389 with the special merged in). The non-Oahu precinct sums for HI-2 (Hawaii 62,500, Maui incl. Kalawao 49,759, Kauai 25,130 two-party votes) match MIT's existing county values exactly.
